name: A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship (ASPIRE)
summary: Sets up technology and incubation centers to accelerate entrepreneurship in the agro-rural sector.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Grant of up to Rs. 100 lakhs (100% of Plant & Machinery cost) for setting up incubation centers.

criteria.description: Not-for-profit private institutions with experience in executing incubation or skill development programs are eligible to apply.
criteria.source_quote: Any not-for-profit private institutions with experience in successfully executing incubation and/or skill development programs may be eligible to set up an LBI.

criteria.description: Applicant must have at least 5000 sq ft space to set up the proposed Livelihood Business Incubator.
criteria.source_quote: Ensuring availability of all necessary compliance documents, and space (5000 sq ft) with the HI to set up the proposed LBIs.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepare a DPR based on regional industrial landscape analysis and skill gaps
Obtain audited accounts to prove organizational track record and fund utilization
Submit registration under Societies Registration Act 1860, Trusts Act, or Companies Act

windows.notes: Proposals can be submitted by eligible institutions via the ASPIRE portal.

benefits.description: One-time grant of up to 100% of cost of Plant & Machinery
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Based on project approval and execution milestones.
benefits.source_quote: one-time grant of 100% of cost of Plant & Machinery other than the land and infrastructure or an amount up to Rs. 100 lakhs whichever is less
